    browser = p.chromium.launch(headless=True)
    page = browser.new_page(viewport={\"width\": 1440, \"height\": 900})

    stack = page.locator('.bookmark-stack')

    search = page.get_by_label('Search bookmarks')
    search.fill('Designing')
    assert stack.locator('.card').count() == 0

    assert page.get_by_text('0 bookmarks found in All bookmarks').is_visible()
    page.locator('#archiveNav').click()
    assert stack.locator('.card').count() == 1
    assert stack.get_by_text('Designing Better Design Systems').is_visible()
    assert page.get_by_text('1 bookmark found in Archive').is_visible()
    page.screenshot(path='prototypes/archive-search-scope.png', full_page=True)
    browser.close()
print('Archive-aware search checked: archived item is absent from All results and appears under the same query in Archive.')
